title: Figure 14: Hypersonic glider characteristics, down range vs. lateral range and L/D
description: Two side-by-side plots. Left: down range vs. lateral range (nautical miles) with a linear fit through red points, highlighting "Nominal Lifting Body" (green) and "Model 176" (purple). Right: hypersonic L/D vs. subsonic L/D with labeled points for "Apollo + Paraglider," "Eggers M2," "Wing-Body," "DynaSoar," "Model 176" and "FDL-7," plus blue triangles for "MDC data." Caption: "Figure 14. Hypersonic Glider Characteristics."
